---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem / motivation**
What are you trying to do, and what's missing or hard today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see. If it touches the core VSA math, note how correctness would be tested
(e.g. an equivalence test against a naive reference).

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches you thought about.

**Scope check**
- [ ] Keeps the core packages dependency-free (stdlib only)
- [ ] Any perf/accuracy claim would be reproducible from committed code
